name: xe-converter
title: 1,000 USD to EUR - US Dollars to Euros Exchange Rate

knownGaps.why:
Two things are red here and the first one is not a shape problem at all.
(1) DEFECT, not a limitation. On a currency converter, XE's six-significant-figure rates are misread as thousands-grouped: "429.109 EUR" renders as 599.7 ZEC, "858.219 EUR" as 1,199 ZEC, "582.602 USD" as 746.9 ZEC and "159.356 JPY" as 1.362 ZEC — each exactly 1000x too high, on the one kind of page whose entire purpose is the number being right. parseNumber in src/lib/detection/parser.ts only takes the US-decimal read when the integer part is a single digit (sepIndex <= 1) AND the currency is in US_DECIMAL_CURRENCIES, which excludes EUR and JPY. The page writes "4,291.09 EUR" and "1,165.2 USD" elsewhere, so its own convention is comma grouping with a dot decimal and is stated in the markup rather than needing to be guessed. The "###.# ZEC" and "#,### ZEC" shapes in this failure exist only because of that misread.
(2) The shape gap outlives the fix, so the entry stays either way: corrected, the page still spans 0.858219 EUR to 27,012.00 USD, and the four-significant-figure cap alone separates "0.0012 ZEC" from "32.56 ZEC".
